assumptions: Principal business (CG-02): taken as the code with the most payroll outside C-110, measured from the records.
Office staff who sign in at job sites are not confined to an office (CG-04); without time records (CG-07) their whole payroll goes to the principal business code (CG-02), however few the visits.
